lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau hau karatee jag phiree naa dhan sa(n)pai naal ||
lines.translation: Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, she wanders around the world, but her wealth and property will not go with her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhee naam na chetaee sabh baadhee jamakaal ||
lines.translation: The spiritually blind do not even think of the Naam; they are all bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satagur miliai dhan paaiaa har naamaa ridai samaal ||3||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the wealth is obtained, contemplating the Name of the Lord in the heart. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam rate se niramale gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; through the Guru, they obtain intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan raataa ra(n)g siu rasanaa rasan rasaai ||
lines.translation: Their minds and bodies are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Love, and their tongues savor His Sublime Essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ra(n)g na utarai jo har dhur chhodiaa laai ||4||14||47||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that Primal Color which the Lord has applied, shall never fade away. ||4||14||47||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh kripaa kare bhagat keejai bin gur bhagat na hoee ||
lines.translation: By His Grace one becomes Gurmukh, worshipping the Lord with devotion. Without the Guru there is no devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapai aap milaae boojhai taa niramal hovai soee ||
lines.translation: Those whom He unites with Himself, understand and become pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu saachaa saachee baanee sabad milaavaa hoee ||1||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Shabad, we merge with Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaee re bhagatiheen kaahe jag aaiaa ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny: those who lack devotion-why have they even bothered to come into the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur kee sev na keenee birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They do not serve the Perfect Guru; they waste away their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape jagajeevan sukhadaataa aape bakhas milaae ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver of Peace. He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t e kiaa vechaare kiaa ko aakh sunaae ||
lines.translation: So what about all these poor beings and creatures? What can anyone say?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh aape dei vadaaee aape sev karaae ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glory. He Himself enjoins us to His Service. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekh kuta(n)b mohi lobhaanaa chaladiaa naal na jaaee ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon their families, people are lured and trapped by emotional attachment, but none will go along with them in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur sev gun nidhaan paaiaa tis dee keem na paaee ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, one finds the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence. His Value cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh sakhaa meet prabh meraa a(n)te hoi sakhaaee ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord God is my Friend and Companion. God shall be my Helper and Support in the end. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanai man chit kahai kahaae bin gur aap na jaaee ||
lines.translation: Within your conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness is not removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu daataa bhagat vachhal hai kar kirapaa ma(n)n vasaaee ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord is the Giver, the Lover of His devotees. By His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sobhaa surat dei prabh aape guramukh de vadiaaee ||4||15||48||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, He bestows enlightened awareness; God Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||4||15||48||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜਨਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਇਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan jananee jin jaaiaa dha(n)n pitaa paradhaan ||
lines.translation: Blessed is the mother who gave birth; blessed and respected is the father of one who serves the True Guru and finds peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur sev sukh paaiaa vichahu gaiaa gumaan ||
lines.translation: His arrogant pride is banished from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਖੜੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dar sevan sa(n)t jan khaRe paain gunee nidhaan ||1||
lines.translation: Standing at the Lord's Door, the humble Saints serve Him; they find the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man gur mukh dhiaai har soi ||
lines.translation: O my mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad man vasai man tan niramal hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and the body and mind become pure. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa ghar aaiaa aape miliaa aai ||
lines.translation: By His Grace, He has come into my home; He Himself has come to meet me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee saalaaheeai ra(n)ge sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: Singing His Praises through the Shabads of the Guru, we are dyed in His Color with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sach samaaiaa mil rahai na vichhuR jaai ||2||
lines.translation: Becoming truthful, we merge with the True One; remaining blended with Him, we shall never be separated again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karanaa s kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Whatever is to be done, the Lord is doing. No one else can do anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chiree vichhu(n)ne melian satagur pa(n)nai paai ||
lines.translation: Those separated from Him for so long are reunited with Him once again by the True Guru, who takes them into His Own Account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape kaar karaaisee avar na karanaa jaai ||3||
lines.translation: He Himself assigns all to their tasks; nothing else can be done. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan rataa ra(n)g siu haumai taj vikaar ||
lines.translation: One whose mind and body are imbued with the Lord's Love gives up egotism and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis hiradai rav rahai nirabhau naam nira(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: Day and night, the Name of the One Lord, the Fearless and Formless One, dwells within the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aap milaaian poorai sabad apaar ||4||16||49||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He blends us with Himself, through the Perfect, Infinite Word of His Shabad. ||4||16||49||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: govid gunee nidhaan hai a(n)t na paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Excellence; His limits cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kathanee badanee na paaeeai haumai vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: He is not obtained by mouthing mere words, but by rooting out ego from within.
